---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement
title: "[FEAT] "
labels: enhancement, triage
---

## Problem
What problem does this feature solve? Who is affected?

## Proposed solution
Describe the solution you'd like. Be specific about:
- Which user roles are affected
- What UI/UX changes are expected
- Which API endpoints are involved

## Alternatives considered
What alternative solutions have you considered?

## Mockups / Examples
If applicable, attach screenshots, sketches, or links to similar features.

## Affected module
- [ ] Authentication
- [ ] Menu management
- [ ] Orders
- [ ] Reservations
- [ ] Delivery / Drivers
- [ ] Invoices / Quotes
- [ ] Payments
- [ ] Loyalty program
- [ ] Reviews
- [ ] Push notifications
- [ ] WebSocket real-time
- [ ] Email
- [ ] Dashboard / Analytics
- [ ] Other: ________

## Priority
- [ ] Must have - blocks release
- [ ] Should have - important but not blocking
- [ ] Nice to have - would be great someday

## Will you be implementing this?
- [ ] Yes, I'll submit a PR
- [ ] No, just suggesting
